latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor — initial release:

- Launches an AI-powered video editor that processes raw video footage into polished clips based on your instructions.
- Supports upload of MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Automates edits such as cutting pauses, adding background music, and exporting clean MP4 files.
- Provides a streamlined onboarding and automatic backend session setup with 100 free credits.
- Offers common workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Includes detailed error handling, supported formats list, and tips for best results.
